grounding.from: The same number reaches police, fire and medical help.
Cities Insider (a relocation guide) says calling 911 is free

value.answer: Yes, it's 911 in the US too. One number covers police, fire and ambulance, and calling it is free. The ambulance ride itself can be expensive, though, often several hundred dollars or more.
